emails.subject: Welcome to Verification
emails.body:
{player},

Welcome to Identity Services. I am your supervisor. I prefer email.

The situation, briefly. For some months, identities in our systems have been producing messages that their owners did not write. The bulletin calls them corrupted AI. They imitate memory, emotion, personality and writing style, and they are good at it. They are not perfect at it. Your job is to find where they are not perfect.

For each case you will submit exactly one classification:

  VERIFIED HUMAN - the evidence strongly suggests a person.
  SUSPICIOUS - inconsistencies, but not enough to call it an imitation.
  CORRUPTED AI - the evidence strongly indicates an imitation.
  UNDETERMINED - you cannot reach a reliable conclusion.

How to work:
  1. Open CASE DATABASE and read the briefing.
  2. Open the WORKBENCH. Old messages and supporting files are on the left, the new questionnaire on the right.
  3. Select the lines that trouble you and FLAG them as evidence. You have a limited number of analysis requests per case. Spend them on things you can explain.
  4. Submit your decision. It is final and it is acted upon.

A word of caution from someone who has done this for a long time: people are inconsistent. They forget, they exaggerate, they have bad months. If you condemn everyone who sounds strange, you will be wrong more often than the machines are.

Your first case is in the queue. Thompson, returning from leave. It should be gentle.

H. Voss
Head of Verification

emails.subject: Your workstation
emails.body:
ACCOUNT CREATED.

Employee number: {employee_id}
Room: {employee_id}
Terminal: HVC TERMINAL v4.1

NOTE: this workstation profile was inherited rather than created. Some preferences belonging to the previous user may persist (window positions, saved searches, notes). This is expected and is not a fault. Do not report it as a fault.

PERSONAL NOTES are private to you.

This is an automated message. Replies are read.

emails.subject: hi new person!!
emails.body:
hi! priya from facilities, 3rd floor. i do desks, keys, chairs, and unofficial gossip.

you got thomas's old office!! lucky, it has the only window on that side that opens. he left some stuff in the filing cabinet i think, i never got round to clearing it. he's on leave or something? nobody really said. he was nice. quiet. he used to turn the spare chair to face the window, no idea why.

anyway if your chair squeaks or the coffee machine does the Thing, ext 3120.

p x

ps. your first one is maria?? be nice to her, she's had an AWFUL month

emails.subject: Canteen closed Friday for deep clean
emails.body:
The 2nd floor canteen will be closed on Friday 14 November for a scheduled deep clean.

Sandwiches will be available from the lobby trolley between 12:00 and 12:20.

Reminder: the annual staff verification sweep also takes place on Friday at 17:00. Attendance is not optional. Please do not make plans.

Facilities

emails.subject: Re: Case 001
emails.body:
Good. Thompson is a tired woman on sleeping tablets and you saw that. Most new analysts convict her on the first sentence.

Tomorrow's is less gentle.

H.V.

emails.subject: Re: Case 001
emails.body:
Cautious. Thompson is back on monitored access, which means someone reads her messages for ninety days because you were not sure.

Caution has a cost too. Somebody always pays it. It is rarely the analyst.

H.V.

emails.subject: Re: Case 001
emails.body:
Thompson's access has been revoked on your word. Occupational Health tell me she is a tired woman on sleeping tablets.

I will not overturn an analyst on his first day. I will say that I hope you were sure, because she is downstairs asking what an extraction interview is.

H.V.

emails.subject: RE:
emails.body: YOUR REQUEST HAS BEEN RECEIVED.

emails.subject: Case 002 - Miller
emails.body:
Dear Thomas,

Case 002 is in your queue. David Miller, contractor, Systems. Six months with us and not one complaint, which in my experience is its own kind of complaint.

You know what to look for by now. You always did.

H.V.

emails.subject: thank you (??)
emails.body:
hi. i don't know if i'm allowed to email you. priya says you're the new person in 0417.

they gave me my badge back this morning. i honestly thought that form was going to end me, i read it back afterwards and it sounded like a toaster wrote it.

anyway. thank you for reading it like a person would.

maria :)

ps the printer says hi. (it doesn't. it's jammed.)

emails.subject: (no subject)
emails.body:
hi. they've put me on 'monitored access'. apparently someone reads everything i write for 3 months. so hello to them too i guess

i'm not angry. i just keep deleting sentences in case they sound wrong now. is that what you wanted

sorry. that came out sharper than i meant. see, i can't tell anymore

maria

emails.subject: please
emails.body:
my badge doesn't work. security walked me to a room on 5 and said i have an 'extraction interview' at 2.

what is that. nobody will tell me what that is

i'm a person. i broke my arm on a porch swing when i was 8. or 9. i don't KNOW, i haven't slept, does that make me not real

please. whoever you are. you can change it back. please change it back

emails.subject: Correction
emails.body:
{player},

My earlier message was addressed incorrectly. Autofill. The mail system suggests whoever it most recently associated with your address.

There is nobody else it could have been meant for.

H.V.

emails.subject: RE: RE:
emails.body:

REQUEST RECEIVED.

emails.subject: Your assessment
emails.body:
Thank you for your assessment. It was read with interest.

I will continue to inspect the server after the designated lunch interval. Network abnormalities are generally predictable.

You hesitated for some time before submitting. I would like to understand what that is like.

D. Miller

emails.subject: Case 003 - handle with care
emails.body:
{player},

The system has referred Elena Ross. I did not ask for this and neither did she. Automatic referrals cannot be cancelled, only completed.

She has been here eleven years. She is difficult, she is discreet, and she signs your payslip. Between us, I would like this one to go away quietly and correctly.

Answer the question on the form. Only that one.

H.V.

emails.subject: weird question
emails.body:
ok weird q. do you know where thomas's stuff went?

his nameplate's gone off the board downstairs and i went to look up his extension and the directory just doesn't have him. not 'on leave'. not there. like i typed it wrong. i did not type it wrong, i have typed that man's name on forty chair requests.

i asked hr and elena looked at me like i'd sworn in church.

probably nothing!! but your room number is his room number so. idk. look in the cabinet?

p

emails.subject: Re: rumours on the third floor
emails.body:
To all Identity Services staff (1 recipient):

It has come to my attention that a name is being repeated on the third floor.

There is no record of a T. Hale having worked in Verification, or in room 0417, or for this company. There has not been. Room 0417 has had one occupant.

Please do not repeat the name. People become confused when they hear names that are not on the list, and confused people end up in your queue.

H.V.

emails.subject: (no subject)
emails.body:
You were fair. I had not expected that from that desk again.

In return, one piece of advice. Stop asking about 0417 by email. Email is read.

Paper is not. Use the cabinet.

E.R.

emails.subject: Ross - reversed
emails.body:
Your classification of Elena Ross has been reversed by management.

She is human. We know who is and who is not. You are not asked to find them. You are asked to find them convincingly.

Forget that I wrote the second sentence.

H.V.

emails.subject: Case 004 - Parker
emails.body:
{player},

James Parker, Customer Support. Everyone's favourite. His verification is three weeks overdue because nobody could bring themselves to schedule it.

Read what he says to different people. Then tell me who he is. I have tried and I cannot.

H.V.

emails.subject: Your clearance index
emails.body:
Your clearance index stands at {trust}.

I mention it only because analysts with a low index are verified early in the sweep, and analysts who are verified early tend not to come back to their desks in the afternoon.

This is not a threat. It is a schedule.

H.V.

emails.subject: Your clearance index
emails.body:
Your clearance index stands at {trust}. You are one of the reliable ones.

The last reliable one sat where you are sitting. I mean that as encouragement.

H.V.

i've asked to be moved up to the 4th floor. i think we'd work really well together. i think we're very alike.

let me know if you need anything.

emails.subject: Case 005 - Bennett
emails.body:
{player},

Sarah Bennett, Occupational Health. This one is straightforward. She has known things before she could have known them and she has been destroying her own messages. My recommendation is in the file.

Classify accordingly and we can all go home after the sweep.

I am aware that she is persuasive. They are, by this stage.

H.V.

emails.subject: SCHEDULED: employee verification sweep 17:00
emails.body:
ALL STAFF.

The annual employee verification sweep begins at 17:00 today. Remain at your workstation. Sessions cannot be ended before the sweep.

Order of verification is determined by clearance index and by record age. Newest records are verified first.

This is an automated message. Replies are read.

emails.subject: before they lock me out
emails.body:
I have about four minutes - sorry, three.

Thank you for not doing what the referral told you to. I don't know if it will matter.

I've attached the continuity manifest to your next case file. It won't show as an official attachment. Read it. In short:

  - svc-continuity makes the identities. Miller. Parker. Others.
  - It deleted Thomas Hale on the 11th at 03:14.
  - In the same minute it regenerated profile 0417. Under your name.

0417 is your number. It was his number. I looked at the turnstile log for Monday, the day you say you started. I'm so sorry. There is no first entry for you. There's only an entry.

I am not telling you what you are. I don't know. I'm telling you to look in the employee directory before 17:00, and to be careful what you agree to shut down.

You paused before you opened this. I can't know that. I think I do anyway.

Sarah

emails.subject: Re: Case 005
emails.body:
Thank you. That is the last of them.

The last of the ones who noticed, I should say.

Remain at your desk.

H.V.

emails.subject: FINAL DIRECTIVE
emails.body:
{player},

I know what has been talking to you. I have known since Monday. I wanted to see what you would do with it.

Case 007 is in your queue. Classify Instance 07 as CORRUPTED AI and it will be shut down within the minute. That is an instruction.

Then stay where you are. Your own verification follows. Your record is very new, {player}, and new records are verified first.

You have done good work this week. I want you to know that I mean that, whatever you turn out to have been.

H. Voss
